description: Build the two Twilio Trust Hub bundles a US 10DLC brand is filed from, from the business details: a customer profile (legalName, businessType, industry, registrationIdType + registrationNumber such as the EIN, website, address, representative) attached to the account's Primary Customer Profile, and an A2P messaging profile (companyType; stockExchange, stockTicker, brandContactEmail for a public company). Each is checked against Twilio's live policy and submitted for Twilio's review; one Twilio finds incomplete is removed and its reasons returned. The Primary Customer Profile itself is made only in the Twilio Console; the answer says so when it is missing. Without confirm:true it only checks and reports the plan. Twilio charges nothing for bundles; register_sms_brand files the brand with the two ids. Free in credits. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

businessType.description: Corporation, Limited Liability Corporation, Partnership, Co-operative or Non-profit Corporation

customerProfileSid.description: reuse a customer profile the account already has (BU…)

industry.description: e.g. RETAIL, TECHNOLOGY, HEALTHCARE, FOOD_AND_BEVERAGE, PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES

legalName.description: the exact legal name registered with the tax id

registrationIdType.description: EIN (default, US), DUNS, CBN, CN, ACN, CIN, VAT, VATRN, RN or Other

registrationNumber.description: the EIN as 00-0000000, or the id registrationIdType names

name: create_sms_registration_bundles
title: Build Twilio's 10DLC registration bundles
